calculation.expression: when lagged daily downside breadth >= 0.60: cross-sectional_median_center(-rolling_sum(pct_change(close), 3)); otherwise null
calculation.description: After at least 60% of the tradable cross-asset universe declined on the prior completed day, rank assets by their negative trailing three-day return, centered by the cross-sectional median. Higher values indicate stronger recent weakness and a reversal opportunity. The signal is lagged and uses only completed daily observations.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in 2020-2022, positive in 2023-2026 and particularly strong in 2025-2026; interpret regime dependence conservatively. Five-day decay passed the benchmark gate while one- and ten-day horizons did not.
